newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Destec Energy upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Destec Energy upgraded.

text.p: -- UBS Securities said it upgraded Destec Energy Inc to buy from hold.
-- cited company's previously announced plan to mull strategic alternatives, such as selling the company. UBS expects a deal to be announced within the next few months.
-- raised the 1997 earnings view to $0.90 a share from $0.80 a share. Set a 1998 earnings estimate of $1.15 a share.
-- said it expects compound annual earnings per share growth of 27 percent to year 2000.
-- Destec gained 7/8 to 18-1/4 in morning trading.
